serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-dependency-auditor
serverInfo.description: MCP server that audits npm, pip, and cargo dependencies for known CVEs using the OSV database

tools.name: audit_npm
tools.description: Audit npm dependencies from a package.json (and optionally package-lock.json) for known CVEs using the OSV database

directory.description: Path to the directory containing package.json

includeDevDeps.description: Include devDependencies in the audit (default: false)

tools.name: audit_pip
tools.description: Audit Python dependencies from requirements.txt or pyproject.toml for known CVEs using the OSV database

directory.description: Path to the directory containing requirements.txt or pyproject.toml

tools.name: audit_package
tools.description: Audit a single package by name, version, and ecosystem

tools.name: audit_directory
tools.description: Auto-detect and audit all supported manifests (package.json, requirements.txt) in a directory

directory.description: Path to the project root directory

includeDevDeps.description: Include dev dependencies for npm (default: false)
